newsitem.title: UK: IGC sees lower US coarse grains trade, higher EU.
newsitem.headline: IGC sees lower US coarse grains trade, higher EU.

text.p: The International Grains Council on Thursday trimmed its estimate for 1996-97 world trade in coarse grains to 88 million tonnes from last month's figure of 89 million tonnes.

The IGC's monthly Grain Market Report put U.S. coarse grains exports at 53.1 million tonnes, down from the previous estimate of 55.1 million, but raised estimated EU exports to 8.1 million tonnes from 7.0 million.

The fall in the estimate for total coarse grains imports includes a drop of 500,000 tonnes for Africa to 7.1 million, a rise of 200,000 tonnes for Saudi Arabia to 6.0 million, and a cut in estimated Japanese imports to 20.3 million tonnes, from the previous 20.5 million.
It put 1995-96 world coarse grains trade at 92 million tonnes. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
